questions.questionTextEn: Most milk yielding goat breed in India is-
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 1994] Most milk yielding goat breed in India is-

questions.questionTextEn: Where are the Tharparkar species found?
questions.questionTextHi: [R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2007] Where are the Tharparkar species found?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Border Region of Rajasthan. Best cow breeds in India are found in Rajasthan. Breeds of cow generally found in Rajasthan are Tharparkar, Rathi, Kankrej, Sahiwal, Lal Sindhi, Gir, Nagouri, Haryanvi, Malwi and Mewati. Among these, Tharparkar breed is found in the western border district of Jaisalmer, Barmer and Jodhpur. [R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2007]
